issues: Top-level stat cards render 0 Total Users / 0 Orders / ₹0 Revenue / 0 Active Members while the Signups & Revenue chart directly below shows real data (Fri revenue:17234, users:19) and the Users/Orders admin sub-pages clearly list 30+ users and 15+ orders. The four hero stat tiles appear to be reading a different (empty) source than the chart. Recommend reconciling AdminDashboard.jsx's stats fetch with the growth data source.

Primary business detail hero says 'Pending kit payment' for EG000043 (user hasn't paid joining kit), but the same user's /dashboard shows 'Businesses: 2/4' (i.e. 2 of the additional businesses are paid & active). It's slightly confusing that the primary business can be Pending while additional businesses under it are Active — consider showing a warning nudge to also pay the primary kit, or a clearer 'Primary — Pending Activation' badge with a Pay CTA.

action_items: Investigate why Admin Overview top hero stat cards (Total Users / Orders / Revenue / Active Members) show 0 while the 7-day chart and sub-pages have real data. Likely a wrong endpoint or missing await/state in AdminDashboard.jsx.

Consider adding a 'Pay primary kit' CTA on /dashboard/businesses when is_primary card is Pending — currently users can activate additional businesses while their own primary is still pending, which is legal but confusing.
Optional: expose a bulk-delete-pending endpoint or DELETE ALL businesses button — right now testing accumulates pending businesses on EG000043.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 2670 lines (from 2431 last iter). Continue the recommended split — /mlm/businesses/* (~140 LOC) and /admin/export/* (~50 LOC) are natural modules to extract into backend/routes/businesses.py and backend/routes/exports.py.

POST /mlm/businesses/create body is untyped `payload: dict` — same issue flagged last iteration. Should be a Pydantic BusinessCreate model with name:str (optional, max_length), referral_code:str (required, upper). Currently no length cap on 'name' — a user could POST 10MB of 'A' as name.

POST /mlm/businesses/create uses a 10-iteration UUID-based referral-code uniqueness loop but does NOT raise if all 10 collide — silently uses last generated value (line 785-786). Extremely unlikely collision but should raise 500 defensively.

The joining kit total in create_business is computed as `price * (1 + gst_percent/100)` (line 817+825) but does NOT include the delivery fee or extra_charges configured in site settings — meaning if admin later enables Packing Fee / Handling %, a business-order will bypass them while a regular /orders/create includes them. Consider routing business-order creation through the same _compute_order_totals helper.

cashfree/verify handler (line 1738-1752) — the business-activation branch and joining-branch are mutually exclusive on `order.business_id`, which is correct, but the notification title includes an emoji 🚀 that will not render in some CSV / older email clients. Fine for in-app but worth noting.

Admin CSV exports have no filter/date-range params — a production admin exporting 10k users/orders/withdrawals returns the full DB in one StreamingResponse chunk (buf.read()). For scale, chunk row-by-row and support ?since=YYYY-MM-DD.
